text: あなたの　ポケモン　すこし　よごれちゃってる　みたい！

structure.jp: あなたの　ポケモン
すこし　よごれちゃってる　みたい！
structure.en: seems to have gotten a little dirty!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing ended up happening, often sadly; ちゃう is the short spoken form. よごれちゃってる = 'has gone and gotten dirty'.

patterns.name: 〜みたい
patterns.span: よごれちゃってる　みたい
patterns.explanation: みたい at the end says 'it looks like', a guess from what you see. よごれちゃってる　みたい = 'it looks like it's gotten dirty'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says the result is still there now; てる is the short spoken form. よごれちゃってる = 'is in a dirtied state'.
